name: Notes
description: Markdown notes in projects, with checklists and autosave; edits on different devices merge. Notes saved from finished tasks live in the Tasks project.

create.description: Create a note: title (optional, defaults to the first line), body (Markdown), project, and focus (used as the project when none is given). Returns its id.

title.description: Title; defaults to the first line of the body. Up to 200 characters.

body.description: Note text in Markdown; use '- [ ] item' for checklist lines.

project.description: Project to file the note in; matches an existing project ignoring case.

focus.description: Fallback project used when project is not given (the page focus).

update.description: Change a note's title (blank follows the first line), body, project or pinned flag.

title.description: New title; blank follows the first line of the body.

body.description: New Markdown text (replaces the whole body).

project.description: New project; blank removes the note from its project.

delete.confirm: Move this note to the trash?

id.description: The note to move to trash.

restore.description: Bring a note back from trash.

id.description: The trashed note to bring back.

to_task.description: Create a To-do task from a line of text.

text.description: The task text; a leading '- [ ]' checklist mark is dropped.

summary.description: Notes created or changed between local dates start and end.

start.description: First local date of the range.

end.description: Last local date of the range (inclusive).

tidy.description: Move a note to trash if it is empty.
tidy.confirm: Move this note to the trash if it is empty?

task_note.description: Save what came of a finished task in its note in the Tasks project: key (the task, or its repeating series), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD), text, tags. One note per key, newest entry first; replace (true when editing a saved note) swaps the entry with the same date. Returns its id.

key.description: The task id, or its repeating series id; one note per key.

text.description: What came of the task (up to 20,000 characters).

tags.description: Comma-separated tags, added only when the note is first created.

replace.description: True to replace the entry with the same date instead of adding one.

review_notes.sql: SELECT id, title, project, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) AS updated_at FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) IS NOT NULL AND (?1 IS NULL OR COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) >= ?1) AND (?2 IS NULL OR COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) < ?2) ORDER BY CASE WHEN ?5 = 'title' AND ?6 = 'asc' THEN title END COLLATE NOCASE ASC, CASE WHEN ?5 = 'title' AND ?6 = 'desc' THEN title END COLLATE NOCASE DESC, CASE WHEN ?5 = 'updated_at' AND ?6 = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) END ASC, CASE WHEN ?5 = 'updated_at' AND ?6 = 'desc' THEN COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) END DESC, id ASC LIMIT ?3 OFFSET ?4
review_notes.description: Created or edited notes in a half-open activity-time range; notes are not completion records.

focus_suggestions.sql: SELECT project AS value, COUNT(*) AS count FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' AND project <> 'Tasks' GROUP BY project ORDER BY count DESC, project LIMIT 30
focus_suggestions.description: Projects in use (except Tasks) with their note counts, most used first.

list.sql: SELECT id, title, project, pinned, (WITH RECURSIVE st(t, n) AS (SELECT substr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(char(10) || substr(body, instr(body || char(10), char(10)) + 1), char(10) || '- [', char(10) || '['), char(10) || '- ', char(10)), char(10), ' '), '[ ] ', '☐ '), '[x] ', '☑ '), '**', ''), '#', ''), 1, 800), 0 UNION ALL SELECT substr(t, 1, instr(t, '](') - 1) || substr(t, instr(t, '](') + instr(substr(t, instr(t, '](')), ')')), n + 1 FROM st WHERE n < 40 AND instr(t, '](') > 0 AND instr(substr(t, instr(t, '](')), ')') > 0) SELECT trim(substr(replace(replace(replace(t, '![', ''), '[', ''), ']', ''), 1, 160)) FROM st ORDER BY n DESC LIMIT 1) AS snippet, CASE WHEN COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?4 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?4, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday' WHEN date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?4, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?4, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END AS edited, (WITH RECURSIVE split(raw, rest, n) AS (SELECT '', body || char(10), 0 UNION ALL SELECT substr(rest, 1, instr(rest, char(10)) - 1), substr(rest, instr(rest, char(10)) + 1), n + 1 FROM split WHERE rest <> ''), lines AS (SELECT rtrim(raw, char(9,10,11,12,13,32,160,5760,8192,8193,8194,8195,8196,8197,8198,8199,8200,8201,8202,8232,8233,8239,8287,12288,65279)) AS raw, n FROM split WHERE n > 0), parsed AS (SELECT ltrim(raw, char(9,10,11,12,13,32,160,5760,8192,8193,8194,8195,8196,8197,8198,8199,8200,8201,8202,8232,8233,8239,8287,12288,65279)) AS line, SUM(substr(ltrim(raw, char(9,10,11,12,13,32,160,5760,8192,8193,8194,8195,8196,8197,8198,8199,8200,8201,8202,8232,8233,8239,8287,12288,65279)), 1, 3) = '```') OVER (ORDER BY n) AS fences FROM lines), tasks AS (SELECT ltrim(substr(line, 2), char(9,10,11,12,13,32,160,5760,8192,8193,8194,8195,8196,8197,8198,8199,8200,8201,8202,8232,8233,8239,8287,12288,65279)) AS task FROM parsed WHERE fences % 2 = 0 AND substr(line, 1, 1) IN ('-', '*') AND length(line) > 1 AND instr(char(9,10,11,12,13,32,160,5760,8192,8193,8194,8195,8196,8197,8198,8199,8200,8201,8202,8232,8233,8239,8287,12288,65279), substr(line, 2, 1)) > 0) SELECT SUM(substr(task, 2, 1) IN ('x', 'X')) || '/' || COUNT(*) FROM tasks WHERE substr(task, 1, 3) IN ('[ ]', '[x]', '[X]') AND length(task) > 4 AND instr(char(9,10,11,12,13,32,160,5760,8192,8193,8194,8195,8196,8197,8198,8199,8200,8201,8202,8232,8233,8239,8287,12288,65279), substr(task, 4, 1)) > 0 HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) AS checklist, CASE WHEN COALESCE(?5, '') IN ('pinned', 'recent', 'trash') THEN NULL WHEN (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes p WHERE p._deleted IS NULL AND p.pinned = 1) = 0 THEN NULL WHEN pinned = 1 THEN 'Pinned' ELSE 'Notes' END AS section FROM (SELECT * FROM notes WHERE (CASE WHEN COALESCE(?5, '') = 'trash' THEN _deleted IS NOT NULL AND NOT (title = 'Untitled' AND trim(COALESCE(body, '')) = '') ELSE _deleted IS NULL END) AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR body LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR project LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') AND (CASE WHEN COALESCE(?5, '') = 'tasks' THEN project = 'Tasks' WHEN COALESCE(?5, '') = 'trash' THEN 1 ELSE ((COALESCE(?2, '') = '' AND COALESCE(project, '') <> 'Tasks') OR project = ?2) END) AND (COALESCE(?5, '') <> 'pinned' OR pinned = 1) AND (COALESCE(?5, '') <> 'recent' OR date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?3) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?4, '-7 day')) ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(?5, '') IN ('recent', 'trash') THEN 0 ELSE pinned END DESC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(?5, '') = 'trash' THEN _deleted END DESC, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 300) AS notes ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(?5, '') IN ('recent', 'trash') THEN 0 ELSE pinned END DESC, CASE WHEN COALESCE(?5, '') = 'trash' THEN _deleted END DESC, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC
list.description: Notes newest first, pinned on top, with a snippet (Markdown links and images reduced to their text), edit time and checklist progress.

q.description: Text to find in title, body or project; empty matches all.

project.description: Only this project (exact name); empty shows all projects except Tasks, 'Tasks' shows task notes.

view.description: Which notes: empty or 'all' for the usual list; 'pinned', 'recent' (edited in the last 7 days), 'tasks' (the Tasks project) or 'trash'.

note.sql: SELECT id, CASE WHEN title = 'Untitled' OR title = trim(ltrim(trim(substr(body, 1, instr(body || char(10), char(10)) - 1)), '#')) THEN '' ELSE title END AS title, body, COALESCE(project, '') AS project, pinned, title AS name, CASE WHEN COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = ?3 THEN strftime('%H:%M', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') = date(?3, '-1 day') THEN 'Yesterday' WHEN date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?3, '-7 day') THEN CASE strftime('%w', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') WHEN '0' THEN 'Sun' WHEN '1' THEN 'Mon' WHEN '2' THEN 'Tue' WHEN '3' THEN 'Wed' WHEN '4' THEN 'Thu' WHEN '5' THEN 'Fri' ELSE 'Sat' END ELSE CAST(strftime('%d', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) || ' ' || substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', (CAST(strftime('%m', (COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch') AS INTEGER) - 1) * 3 + 1, 3) || CASE WHEN substr(date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) <> substr(?3, 1, 4) THEN ' ' || substr(date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?2) / 1000, 'unixepoch'), 1, 4) ELSE '' END END AS edited FROM notes WHERE id = ?1 AND _deleted IS NULL
note.description: One note with its title (blank when it just follows the first line), body, project, pinned flag, stored title as name, and an edited label.

projects.sql: SELECT '' AS project, 'All' AS label, COUNT(*) AS count, (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '') AS selected FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND COALESCE(project, '') <> 'Tasks' UNION ALL SELECT project, project, COUNT(*), project = ?1 FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' GROUP BY project ORDER BY 1
projects.description: Projects with note counts, plus an 'All' row; the given project is marked selected.

project.description: The currently selected project; empty selects All.

nav_counts.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND COALESCE(project, '') <> 'Tasks') AS all_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND COALESCE(project, '') <> 'Tasks' AND pinned = 1) AS pinned, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND COALESCE(project, '') <> 'Tasks' AND date((COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) + ?1) / 1000, 'unixepoch') > date(?2, '-7 day')) AS recent, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project = 'Tasks') AS tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NOT NULL AND NOT (title = 'Untitled' AND trim(COALESCE(body, '')) = '')) AS trash
nav_counts.description: Sidebar counts: all notes, pinned, edited in the last 7 days, task notes and trash. Each equals the rows its Notes view shows (up to the list's 300-row cap).

nav_projects.sql: SELECT project, COUNT(*) AS count, (project = ?1) AS selected FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' AND project <> 'Tasks' GROUP BY project ORDER BY project COLLATE NOCASE, project
nav_projects.description: Projects (except Tasks) with note counts; the given project is marked selected.

project.description: The currently selected project; empty selects none.

pinned.sql: SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND pinned = 1 ORDER BY title LIMIT 8
pinned.description: Up to 8 pinned notes by title.

trash.sql: SELECT id, title FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NOT NULL AND NOT (title = 'Untitled' AND trim(COALESCE(body, '')) = '') ORDER BY _deleted DESC LIMIT 100
trash.description: Notes in the trash, most recently deleted first (empty notes left out).

search.sql: SELECT id, title, COALESCE(project, trim(substr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(char(10) || substr(body, instr(body || char(10), char(10)) + 1), char(10) || '- [', char(10) || '['), char(10) || '- ', char(10)), char(10), ' '), '[ ] ', '☐ '), '[x] ', '☑ '), '**', ''), '#', ''), 1, 160))) AS subtitle FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND (title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR body LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') ORDER BY pinned DESC, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 8
search.description: Up to 8 notes whose title or body contains the text.

project_names.sql: SELECT DISTINCT project FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND project IS NOT NULL AND project <> '' ORDER BY project
project_names.description: Names of all projects that have notes, including Tasks.

recent.sql: SELECT id, title, pinned, trim(substr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(char(10) || substr(body, instr(body || char(10), char(10)) + 1), char(10) || '- [', char(10) || '['), char(10) || '- ', char(10)), char(10), ' '), '[ ] ', '☐ '), '[x] ', '☑ '), '**', ''), '#', ''), 1, 160)) AS snippet, project FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND COALESCE(project, '') <> 'Tasks' AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR project = ?1 COLLATE NOCASE OR title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR body LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') AND (?2 IS NULL OR ?2 = '' OR project = ?2 COLLATE NOCASE) ORDER BY pinned DESC, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) DESC LIMIT 5
recent.description: The 5 most recent notes (pinned first), excluding task notes.

focus.description: Page focus: matches a project name (ignoring case) or text in title or body; empty matches all.

project.description: Only this project (ignoring case); empty for any.

index_notes.sql: SELECT id, title, substr(body, 1, 20000) AS body, project AS keywords, COALESCE(project, trim(substr(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(replace(char(10) || substr(body, instr(body || char(10), char(10)) + 1), char(10) || '- [', char(10) || '['), char(10) || '- ', char(10)), char(10), ' '), '[ ] ', '☐ '), '[x] ', '☑ '), '**', ''), '#', ''), 1, 160))) AS subtitle FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))
index_notes.description: Notes by id, for the host's search index.

ref_notes.sql: SELECT id, title, project AS subtitle FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND id IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?1))

export_notes.sql: SELECT title, body, project FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL ORDER BY project, title

host_notes.sql: SELECT id, title, project, pinned, COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) AS updated_at FROM notes WHERE _deleted IS NULL AND (?1 IS NULL OR ?1 = '' OR title LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR body LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%' OR project LIKE '%' || ?1 || '%') AND ((COALESCE(?2, '') = '' AND COALESCE(project, '') <> 'Tasks') OR project = ?2) ORDER BY pinned DESC, CASE WHEN ?3 = 'title' AND ?4 = 'asc' THEN title END COLLATE NOCASE ASC, CASE WHEN ?3 = 'title' AND ?4 = 'desc' THEN title END COLLATE NOCASE DESC, CASE WHEN ?3 = 'updated_at' AND ?4 = 'asc' THEN COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) END ASC, CASE WHEN ?3 = 'updated_at' AND ?4 = 'desc' THEN COALESCE(updated_at, created_at) END DESC, id ASC LIMIT ?5 OFFSET ?6
host_notes.description: All active notes in pinned and edit-time order, with query-side pagination.

import.label: Notes from a folder of Markdown files
